_comment: The newest release of each source this fork has pulled from. Written by the update-upstream-calibre skill in the same commit as the pull, so it matches what zen holds. For calibre, 'pulled' is merged and must equal packaging/upstream.json 'version'. For Calibre Zen nothing is merged, only cherry-picked: 'reviewed' is the origin/zen commit whose changes were read (start the next read after it) and 'taken' lists the commits cherry-picked. Its web app and website are never taken. 'picked' (calibre) lists upstream commits cherry-picked after the pulled tag; the identity test accepts the files they touch.

calibre_zen.policy: cherry-pick macOS fixes only; never its web app (src/calibre_zen/web, /app/) or website
